brief.question: Can the complete twenty-entry reduced H6 formula be numerically assembled for pure momentum and a nonzero-monopole mixed direction under fixed component and total error gates?
brief.from_parent: Parent validated sources, nine Fourier controls, synthetic tails and both gravitational-tail cases in 95 seconds. It did not compile the production mixed nested kernels or evaluate H6. This child adds exact ten-mode canonical terms, Decimal full triple integrals, the twenty-family ledger and independent pure-momentum reference.
brief.healthy: Completed controls and all exact canonical identities pass; source/T2 checks pass; each family converges and the sum of physical absolute diagnostics meets the declared total budget. Pure momentum has exactly two energy families with coefficients49 and28 and matches the pinned independent radial reference. Mixed H6 may be positive or negative.
brief.noise: Signed family values are different contributions, not a convergence curve. Strong-minus-weak pointwise A2 density need not vanish. accuracy_certified=false and independent_mixed_functional_validation=false are intentional. Exact compiler progress may remain within one kernel for minutes; raw visit counters show activity.
